name: hexagon-pattern

frames.best_why: The highlighted cells read most clearly against the honeycomb with the neck of the fade strongest.

tagline: A faint honeycomb of hexagons with a few cells lit up.
summary: An SVG honeycomb backdrop: faint outlined hexagons tile the whole area and fade at the edges, with a handful of cells filled in to draw the eye where you place them.
appearance: A dark honeycomb of flat-top hexagons drawn in faint grey outlines, tiled across the stage and fading out at the edges. A dozen cells are filled with a soft grey wash, scattered unevenly.
behaviour: Static: nothing moves or responds. The filled cells are fixed by the coordinate list passed in, not by hover or time.
search_phrases: filled cells in a honeycomb grid
use_when: A dark section wants a geometric, technical texture with a few accent cells.
avoid_when: Behind dense content: the faint pattern adds noise without carrying meaning.
customise: Cell radius, gap, offsets, orientation, dash style and a list of cells to fill are props; the stroke colour comes from classes.
weight_why: One tiled SVG pattern and a few polygons; no script or animation.

a11y.note: Decorative and aria-hidden, so assistive tech ignores it; nothing here needs operating.

polish_why: Even honeycomb and a tasteful scatter of lit cells; the pattern stays very faint overall.
title: Hexagon Pattern
